chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, all from Bakr ibn Muhammad al-Azdi, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), regarding the amulet.

He (peace be upon him) said: 'Take a new jar and put water in it, then recite upon it "We have indeed revealed it in the Night of Predestination" thirty times, then hang it, and drink from it and perform ablution with it, and increase the water in it, God willing.'

key_terms.الْعُوذَةِ: Amulet or charm, a vessel or object used for seeking protection or healing
key_terms.قُلَّةً: A small jar or water vessel
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ: The Night of Decree/Predestination, the 19th, 21st, 23rd, or 27th of Ramadan
key_terms.يُزْدَادُ: To be increased or added to

ai.seo_question: How is water prepared and used as a spiritual remedy according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) prescribes a specific ritual for preparing blessed water (mā' al-zamzam style) by reciting Surah Al-Qadr thirty times, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the spiritual potency of the Quran in physical healing. The instruction to use a 'new vessel' and the ability to replenish the water highlights the practical application of divine words (kalimāt) as a means of attaining barakah in daily life. This practice underscores the belief that the Quran is not merely for recitation but serves as a tangible source of healing and purification when applied with faith.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, Altogether from Bakr Bin Muhammad Al Azdy, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the amulet.

Heasws said: ‘Take a new jar and make water to be in it. Then recite upon it [97:1] We have indeed revealed this in the Night of Predestination (Chapter 97), thirty times, then hang it (somewhere), and drink from it, and perform ablution (from it), and increase the water in it, Allahazwj Willing’.
en.sarwar: 19. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father all from Bakar ibn Muhammad al-Azdi from a man from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who about supplications for protection has said the following:

“Find a new pot made of clay and fill it with water then read Chapter 97 of the Holy Quran on it thirty times, then hang it from something, use it for drink and wuzu and add water if so desired (if Allah wills).”
